info.title: drillpress
info.description: Drill Press DrillPress.Cli: composable C# convention rules. All 0.0.X releases are alpha builds and may introduce breaking changes.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
check reports findings; fix applies common-safe edits and reports the recheck.
Targets: .sln, .slnx, .csproj, directory, .cs file, or quoted C# glob.

options.name: --rules
options.description: --property Name=Value (repeatable)  Override MSBuild properties; restore SDK targets first.

options.name: --include-referenced-projects
options.description: Also lint dependencies of a project target (default: selected project only).

options.name: --validate-compilation
options.description: Reject compiler errors.  --profile  Write phase timings to stderr.

options.name: --explain-coverage
options.description: Show typed reasons, context identity and matching source ranges.

options.name: --refresh-coverage
options.description: Rerun tests even when cached coverage inputs match.

options.name: --show-fix-complexity
options.description: Include assigned agent fix effort once per rule.
